milestone: MassBoot R2 / M1 exact-unit passive board imaging
objective: Obtain a complete high-resolution photographic record of both faces of the owner's exact v42012 Ditoo Plus main PCB and relevant connector/pad/component regions so USB, GPIO6/UART0, RESET and SPI-NOR routing can be reasoned about before any electrical experiment.

preconditions.battery: disconnect through an ordinary accessible connector only if straightforward; no cutting/desoldering/forced removal
preconditions.recording: capture original full-resolution still images; do not rely on compressed screenshots

allowed: controlled non-destructive disassembly sufficient to expose both main-PCB faces
high-resolution still photography and ordinary camera/video documentation
repositioning removable covers/connectors only as normally required for non-destructive access
required_photo_set: full straight-on main-PCB face A plus oblique views
full straight-on main-PCB face B plus oblique views
AK1052D marking/package macro with pin-1 orientation and surrounding board
USB-C region macro on both corresponding PCB faces including nearby passives/vias/test pads
SPI-NOR full marking/package macro and surrounding passives/test pads
all inter-board flex/wire/connector routing before optional disconnection
forbidden: powering or booting the device while open as part of this experiment
flash programmer or SPI clip attachment
soldering, desoldering, trace cutting or component removal

evidence_to_capture: any unexpected board-to-board connectors or daughterboards

required_outputs: ranked candidate endpoints for USB_DM/USB_DP, GPIO6/UART0_TXD, GPIO7/UART0_RXD and RESET
identified GND/3.3V candidates only where photographically supportable
smallest unpowered M2 measurements needed to discriminate unresolved mappings
analysis_contract.prohibition: Do not promote an unlabeled or merely nearby test pad to a signal identity without measurement.

risk.reason: No powered/electrical operation is authorized; remaining risk is ordinary mechanical handling, connector damage, ESD or accidental short/contact during disassembly.

stop_if_access_requires: cutting/glue destruction beyond ordinary non-destructive access
direct manipulation of unidentified electrical pads
stop_policy.on_uncertain_disassembly: Stop and capture the best accessible photos rather than forcing deeper access.
stop_policy.after: Reassemble normally or leave safely unpowered for later owner decision; no M2 electrical measurement is authorized by this manifest.

authority.grant_scope: ONE non-destructive, unpowered exact-unit Ditoo Plus disassembly/photo session to capture the frozen M1 photo set only; no electrical measurements, USB/UART, GPIO/reset manipulation, service/factory entry, MassBoot commands, firmware/RAM/flash access, or soldering.
